source.title: Niche: the ultimate grind size guide for Niche grinders (espresso 5–20)
source.notes: Niche's dial-in article narrows it to 10–20, start at 15, and maps 10–20 to 200–400 µm. Honest Coffee Guide 15–30; Coffee Chronicler 9–24; completehomebarista 10–20.

source.notes: Coffee Chronicler 18–24. Honest Coffee Guide 30–53 sits far coarser than Niche's range.

source.title: Niche: the ultimate grind size guide for Niche grinders (AeroPress 30–35)
source.notes: Coffee Chronicler 24–40; completehomebarista 20–28; Honest Coffee Guide 26–77.

source.title: Niche: the ultimate grind size guide for Niche grinders (V60 35–45)
source.notes: Niche's dial-in article says V60 35–50 and maps 35–50 to 600–800 µm. Honest Coffee Guide 33–56; completehomebarista 30–40; Coffee Chronicler pour over 40–50.

source.title: Niche: the ultimate grind size guide for Niche grinders (French press 45+)
source.notes: Niche gives '45+' with no upper limit; 60 is the end of the usable blank zone past the printed 50. completehomebarista 45–55; Coffee Chronicler 55; Honest Coffee Guide 56–64.

procedure.en: Clean the grinder and fit the funnel hand-tight. Rotate the top dial clockwise until the burrs touch. Rotate the black bezel until the silver ball lines up with the 'Calibrate' mark. Turn counter-clockwise to your setting. Never grind at the calibrate position.
procedure.pt-BR: Limpe o moedor e encaixe o funil apertando com a mão. Gire o dial superior no sentido horário até as mós se tocarem. Gire o bezel preto até a bolinha prateada alinhar com a marca 'Calibrate'. Gire no sentido anti-horário até o seu ajuste. Nunca moa na posição de calibração.

notes: Stepless. The funnel ring is numbered 0–50 with a blank zone usable past 50; values here are marks from your own calibrated zero. Niche says a 5–7 mark difference between units is normal. Niche's micron map: 10–20 = 200–400 µm, 35–50 = 600–800 µm (about 13–20 µm per mark, computed). Community rows without a Niche counterpart are not stored as bands: Honest Coffee Guide Turkish 4–17, pour over 34–75, cold brew 65–73; completehomebarista Chemex 35–45, cold brew 50–60. Calibration article: nichecoffee.co.uk/blogs/exploring-coffee/how-to-calibrate-your-grinder-for-optimum-performance. Dial-in article: nichecoffee.co.uk/blogs/exploring-coffee/how-to-dial-in-your-niche-zero.
